_comment: Copy this to bed-map.json and fill in your real device IPs. Bed identity always comes from this mapping, never from the device message itself — see src/bedMapping/bedMap.js. A plain bedId string (like the first two entries) uses the default adapter (BplVividVueM10, HL7). For any other device model, use the {bedId, deviceType} object form (third entry) — deviceType must match one of adapters/registry.js's registered adapters, and the device must be pointed at the right port for its protocol family (HL7_PORT for HL7 adapters, JSON_PORT for JSON ones).
